questions.Q1_required_set: The inputs of MD-S050-R0007..R0015 at the granularity the contract names them. Component completeness (calendar dependency dates, status members, event verification states, factor decisions, contamination) is established at binding with named missing paths and consumed by admission through the VERIFIED verdict; the combined replay hashes are projections of the verified bundle, not the inputs.
questions.Q2_calendar_status: Present and valid when VERIFIED. A missing calendar session for any required or history date, or a damaged status member, is a named binding missing path (calendar_session.required_date.*, status_expectation.*); binding refuses, no V2 context exists, and replay is BLOCKED as REPLAY_BOUND_INPUT_CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE. A null compatibility member under a complete VERIFIED capture is Binding-nullable (no captured basis for that derivation), not a missing input. Guards: B18ProducerCalendarRegistryTest::test_completion_names_one_uncaptured_history_date_and_missing_full_revision_contracts, B18ProducerTradingStatusPopulationTest::test_validator_names_one_damaged_status_member.
questions.Q3_event_factor: Same disposition. event_factor and ancillary are required slots; a damaged member is a named missing path (event_factor.<slot>.INPUT_CAPTURE_FACTOR_SET_CONTENT); Seal also requires source_scale_assessment_set_hash, factor_decision_set_hash and factor_set_hash. Guards: B18ProducerEventFactorCaptureTest::test_c08_whole_manifest_names_a_corrupted_persisted_capture_as_a_gap, ::test_c08_repaired_hash_cannot_hide_single_member_or_decision_damage.
questions.Q4_config_marker: Disguised missing input. The authority requires snapshot ID and hash; configIdentityForRun() documents the marker as a gap "to be closed by binding config identity on the run". Current behaviour: a run with config_snapshot_id and no config_hash replays ADMISSIBLE/PASS with config_snapshot_hash CONFIG_IDENTITY_UNRECORDED, and the storage check accepts the non-empty marker. Demonstrated by a temporary admission block (run config_hash empty -> REPLAY_CONFIG_UNBOUND): 41 of 51 B18ReplayComparisonExhaustivenessTest and 11 of 22 ReplayVerificationServiceTest tests turned red because their fixtures pass on the marker. The change was reverted (service sha256 back to cb2d14dce588cf77115b7eae0b7ff23574f00c12d9b8dfb16f74b5aae5fac2d6) because MariaDB became unreachable and the broad regression a production change requires could not run. RESIDUAL GAP A.
questions.Q5_read_model_version: In the required set (Replay_Verification_Contract_LOCKED.md:30, MD-S050-R0014). PUBLICATION_EXACT service admission enforces it (G03 case). AS_KNOWN does not: AsKnownReplaySnapshotService reads governance.read_model_version, which config/market_data.php does not define (confirmed at runtime: governance keys are config_snapshot_schema_version, config_serialization_version, config_registry_revision, config_resolver_version, build_id, environment_profile, credential_profile), so every AS_KNOWN replay records read_model_version empty and can PASS. The direct-write check omits read_model_version in both modes, so the seven-field boundary is insufficient. AS_KNOWN reason_registry_hash hashes nominal state names plus an undefined governance.reason_registry_revision -- the same disguised-missing shape. RESIDUAL GAP B; its minimal fail-closed remedy would BLOCK every AS_KNOWN replay, which needs an owner decision against binding an as-known read-model/reason-registry identity (MD-S050-R0014).
